theme: War of the Spark: The Fall of Nicol Bolas — the God-Pharaoh vs the Gatewatch
status: FINISHED STORY-FIRST PROPOSAL — not approved/locked by Cory
narrator_note: Five-color Ravnican parun revived during the war and later Living Guildpact; chosen for real narrative relevance, not merely color access. His own rebirth is told by Firemind Vessel, Gateway Plaza, Finale of Promise and the official Operation Desperation story.
canon_caveats: Nicol Bolas is imprisoned and diminished, not canonically killed. Prison Realm stands for Ugin's confinement.
Gideon dies intercepting Liliana's fatal punishment; Liliana's Triumph is independence, not proof that she defeated Bolas alone.
Each of Ravnica's ten Guildgates is geography and guild context, not a literal documented set-piece battle.
The old Nicol Bolas and Amonkhet/Kaladesh cards are prequel scenes, not War of the Spark 2019 printings.
Individual Planeswalkers not listed are not evidence of absence from the war; the deck selects story-defining pages rather than exhaustive cameos.
The Finale of Promise depicts Niv-Mizzet's rebirth per official Wizards card design commentary.
Planewide Celebration is a hopeful coda; individual combat outcomes need separate sources.

beats.title: I. The God-Pharaoh lays his trap: Amonkhet, Kaladesh, Ixalan and Ravnica

cards.name: Nicol Bolas, the Ravager
cards.why: The elder dragon before the final war; a character portrait of the architect of the multiyear plan.

cards.name: Nicol Bolas, God-Pharaoh
cards.why: Bolas rules Amonkhet through manufactured devotion and prepares an undead army.

cards.name: Hour of Devastation
cards.why: The fall of Amonkhet and the crushing of the Gatewatch show the cost of Bolas's earlier scheme.

cards.name: God-Pharaoh's Gift
cards.why: The Amonkhet necromantic machinery behind the Eternal army that will later march on Ravnica.

cards.name: The Chain Veil
cards.why: Liliana's dangerous artifact and a visual link to her role as Bolas's coerced general.

cards.name: The Immortal Sun
cards.why: The anti-planeswalking device transported to Ravnica to keep Planeswalkers trapped during the Elderspell harvest.

cards.name: Planar Bridge
cards.why: The Kaladesh device Tezzeret carries into Bolas's scheme to move the Eternal army between planes.

cards.name: Tezzeret, Master of the Bridge
cards.why: Bolas's operative enabling the Planar Bridge's use in the invasion.

cards.name: Dovin, Hand of Control
cards.why: Bolas-aligned authority figure who takes over the Azorius apparatus.

cards.name: Domri, Anarch of Bolas
cards.why: Bolas's short-lived Gruul ally, manipulated into serving the dragon's invasion plans.

cards.name: Niv-Mizzet, Parun
cards.why: The original dragon parun makes contingency plans for his own death and later five-color resurrection before the invasion begins.

cards.name: God-Pharaoh's Statue
cards.why: Bolas imposes his own image on the occupied city, a symbol later toppled in defiance.

cards.name: Bolas's Citadel
cards.why: The villain's command center during the invasion and spark-harvest scheme.

beats.title: II. The Eternals descend: Ravnica becomes a battlefield

cards.name: Commence the Endgame
cards.why: War of the Spark's Bolas quotation announces his ambition to humble even gods.

cards.name: Dreadhorde Invasion
cards.why: Direct War of the Spark enchantment depicting the Amonkhet army crossing over.

cards.name: Invade the City
cards.why: War of the Spark flavor and artwork identify the arriving Eternal host.

cards.name: Enter the God-Eternals
cards.why: The four corrupted Amonkhet gods enter the conflict.

cards.name: God-Eternal Oketra
cards.why: The undead incarnation of Amonkhet's Oketra, wielded as an invasion weapon.

cards.name: God-Eternal Kefnet
cards.why: Bolas's corrupted version of Kefnet enters Ravnica.

cards.name: God-Eternal Rhonas
cards.why: The corrupted Rhonas joins the invading gods.

cards.name: God-Eternal Bontu
cards.why: The corrupted Bontu will later be turned against Bolas during the climax.

cards.name: Neheb, Dreadhorde Champion
cards.why: The once-proud Amonkhet warrior raised as one of Bolas's Eternals.

cards.name: Herald of the Dreadhorde
cards.why: Its printed flavor explicitly explains Amonkhet's dead crossing to a new plane in service to Bolas.

cards.name: Grim Initiate
cards.why: The original War of the Spark flavor describes the once-living warriors trapped within lazotep.

cards.name: No Escape
cards.why: Jace correctly realizes they have walked into Bolas's trap; an unusually direct narrative quote.

cards.name: Eternal Taskmaster
cards.why: Jace's original quote identifies the Eternals as relentless killers.

cards.name: Ravnica at War
cards.why: The city's center is devastated as the invasion begins; direct War of the Spark scene.

beats.title: III. The Gatewatch and guilds rally; Niv-Mizzet returns

cards.name: Gideon Blackblade
cards.why: Gideon wields Blackblade in the battle and becomes the central sacrificial hero.

cards.name: Liliana, Dreadhorde General
cards.why: Liliana commands the Eternal army for Bolas before rejecting his control.

cards.name: Jace, Wielder of Mysteries
cards.why: The mind mage helps the coalition discover how to defeat Bolas.

cards.name: Chandra, Fire Artisan
cards.why: Gatewatch pyromancer fights the invaders and Dovin's authority.

cards.name: Nissa, Who Shakes the World
cards.why: Nissa rallies the living world of Ravnica to oppose the invading dead.

cards.name: Ugin, the Ineffable
cards.why: Bolas's twin is central to understanding the gem and to the final prison-realm solution.

cards.name: Ajani, the Greathearted
cards.why: Ajani stands with Gideon and the defenders, calling for mutual protection.

cards.name: Kaya, Bane of the Dead
cards.why: Guild leader and defender who takes part in uniting the opposing forces.

cards.name: Teyo, the Shieldmage
cards.why: The young planeswalker protects the ritual that restores Niv-Mizzet in the official story.

cards.name: Ral, Storm Conduit
cards.why: Izzet guildmage and conduit to the plan and signals around the Planeswalker trap.

cards.name: Vraska, Swarm's Eminence
cards.why: Golgari queen whose guild and loyalties are entangled with Bolas's schemes.

cards.name: Contentious Plan
cards.why: War printing says Niv had devised the solution but could not force the guilds to adopt it.

cards.name: Firemind Vessel
cards.why: Original War text explicitly says Niv left the physical components needed for resurrection.

cards.name: Finale of Promise
cards.why: The red finale depicts Niv-Mizzet's rebirth according to Wizards' official card design commentary.

cards.name: Pledge of Unity
cards.why: Gideon's original War quote calls every citizen to become a hero together.

cards.name: Awakening of Vitu-Ghazi
cards.why: Nissa orders the giant living tree to attack the Dreadhorde; the scene is explicit in flavor.

cards.name: Parhelion II
cards.why: Boros angels and the Parhelion join the skies of Ravnica against the invasion.

beats.title: IV. Liliana defies Bolas; Gideon's final sacrifice

cards.name: Divine Arrow
cards.why: War flavor narrates Oketra shooting Gideon's pegasus as he carries Blackblade.

cards.name: Tyrant's Scorn
cards.why: Bolas's quote mocks the storybook idea of a hero with a sword slaying a dragon.

cards.name: Desperate Lunge
cards.why: The original printing describes Gideon's desperate Blackblade attack on Bolas.

cards.name: Unlikely Aid
cards.why: The Rakdos quote to Gideon recalls the demon helping the unexpected hero.

cards.name: Spark Harvest
cards.why: The original flavor directly identifies the harvesting of Domri's spark as the Elderspell's beginning.

cards.name: The Elderspell
cards.why: The named ritual for draining captured Planeswalkers' sparks to power Bolas.

cards.name: Command the Dreadhorde
cards.why: War flavor literally shows Liliana forcing herself to command Bolas's undead army behind the Chain Veil.

cards.name: Price of Betrayal
cards.why: Printed scene of Liliana knowingly rejecting Bolas's contract and choosing her own fate despite the death penalty.

cards.name: Gideon's Sacrifice
cards.why: Direct named event: Gideon intercepts Liliana's fatal punishment and dies in her place.

cards.name: Heartwarming Redemption
cards.why: War epilogue shows Kytheon/Gideon finally at peace after lifelong fighting.

cards.name: Despark
cards.why: Printed scene depicts Liliana convincing the corrupted Amonkhet gods to turn against their false master.

cards.name: Finale of Eternity
cards.why: The War flavor states the tyrant's weakness: someone no longer afraid.

cards.name: Liliana's Triumph
cards.why: The original flavor captures Liliana's victory as freedom rather than survival.

beats.title: V. The final struggle, Bolas's defeat, and Gideon's legacy

cards.name: Storm the Citadel
cards.why: Ajani's quote commits the defenders to the last desperate assault on Bolas.

cards.name: Topple the Statue
cards.why: A rallying victory as the resistance tears down Bolas's monument.

cards.name: Sarkhan's Catharsis
cards.why: Sarkhan's original War quotation directly addresses Bolas for destroying his homeland and mind.

cards.name: Finale of Revelation
cards.why: Ugin recognizes the significance of the gem connecting Bolas to the Meditation Realm.

cards.name: Finale of Devastation
cards.why: Wild creatures join Ravnica's last major resistance; the card is part of the official finale cycle.

cards.name: Finale of Glory
cards.why: The angelic host arrives to fight in the skies, part of the original official finale cycle.

cards.name: Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God
cards.why: The central War of the Spark printing of Bolas at the height of his attempted godhood, immediately before his final defeat and confinement.

cards.name: Prison Realm
cards.why: War flavor directly gives Bolas an eternity to face his failure; represents Ugin's imprisonment rather than a literal grave.

cards.name: Gideon's Triumph
cards.why: The original flavor memorializes Gideon's victory through his saving others.

cards.name: Jace's Triumph
cards.why: Jace learns the limits of Bolas's pursuit of absolute power.

cards.name: Chandra's Triumph
cards.why: Chandra's triumph is a change in self-understanding, not a claim she killed Bolas.

cards.name: Nissa's Triumph
cards.why: Nissa's victory is nurturing life instead of merely destroying threats.

beats.title: VI. Ravnica's ten guilds and the planeswalker trap — lands

cards.name: Azorius Guildgate
cards.why: The Azorius Senate: Dovin's temporary power base and one of Ravnica's ten guilds.

cards.name: Dimir Guildgate
cards.why: House Dimir's contribution of agents and intrigue to the defense.

cards.name: Rakdos Guildgate
cards.why: The Cult of Rakdos, including the demon's unexpected help to Gideon.

cards.name: Gruul Guildgate
cards.why: Gruul territory and Domri's disastrous allegiance.

cards.name: Selesnya Guildgate
cards.why: The Conclave and Vitu-Ghazi's counterattack.

cards.name: Orzhov Guildgate
cards.why: The Orzhov Syndicate and Kaya's place in the war.

cards.name: Izzet Guildgate
cards.why: Niv-Mizzet and Ral's guild of Izzet mages.

cards.name: Golgari Guildgate
cards.why: Vraska's Golgari faction in the citywide coalition.

cards.name: Boros Guildgate
cards.why: Gideon, Aurelia, Feather and the Boros front.

cards.name: Simic Guildgate
cards.why: The Simic presence among Ravnica's guilds as its defenses unite.

cards.name: Blast Zone
cards.why: Ravnica's bombed-out battle geography in the war set.

cards.name: Emergence Zone
cards.why: Direct War flavor pinpoints the Planar Bridge appearing above and destroying the Chamber of the Guildpact.

cards.name: Gateway Plaza
cards.why: War flavor identifies the magical portal scar where guild leaders concentrate power for Niv-Mizzet's rebirth.

cards.name: Interplanar Beacon
cards.why: The signal for gathering planeswalkers across the Multiverse into Bolas's trap.

cards.name: Karn's Bastion
cards.why: Karn's original War flavor pledges to protect those he can.

cards.name: Mobilized District
cards.why: The city's neighborhoods mobilize as one; the original flavor honors cooperation.

cards.name: Plaza of Harmony
cards.why: Ravnica's guild unity made physical before and during the war.

cards.name: Guildmages' Forum
cards.why: The guildmages' shared city infrastructure, context for the reluctant coalition.

cards.name: Aether Hub
cards.why: Kaladesh energy infrastructure, origin-plane context for Tezzeret's stolen Planar Bridge.

cards.name: Survivors' Encampment
cards.why: Amonkhet's surviving civilians after the Hour of Devastation, antecedent to the war's undead army.
